title: PACT Parley Create Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/parleys — open an ephemeral, time-bounded, small-N (2-5) negotiation. The caller is the opener and supplies the opener's Mandate. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 19.5).

purpose.description: Human-readable statement of what the Parley is about. Carried into the outcome and into every participant's state.

ttl_seconds.description: Requested lifetime from `active`. The EFFECTIVE TTL is the minimum of this and the earliest expires_at across accepted Mandates — a Parley never outlives the narrowest authority inside it (19.4).

expected_participants.description: Total participants including the opener. More than 5 MUST be rejected with parley.too_many_participants (19.4).

outcome_binding.description: 'commitment' requires a per-handler 17.6 authorization_proof from EVERY participant at close (19.8). An implementation that cannot verify Section 17 proofs MUST reject 'commitment'.

predecessor_parley_id.description: Optional link to a prior Parley (19.9). Metadata only — no state carries forward. Its existence is itself subject to 17.13 disclosure.

examples.purpose: Agree the v3 event-schema interface contract

mandate.identity_claim: This agent represents Knox on API contract negotiation.

must_respect.boundary: No breaking changes to the event v1 schema
